title: Longitudinal Bayesian Learning of Continuous Disease Position across the Alzheimer's Disease Continuum
abstract: arXiv:2608.19436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progresses as a continuous biological process, whereas most existing neuroimaging-based artificial intelligence methods remain limited to discrete diagnosis or clinical score prediction from cross-sectional imaging. In this work, we propose Disease Continuum Positioning (DCP), a longitudinal Bayesian Learning framework that continuously estimates disease severity from longitudinal diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). Specifically, DCP models disease severity as a low-dimensional probabilistic latent variable by jointly integrating longitudinal observations with weak clinical supervision, from which the proposed Disease Continuum Score (DCS) is derived to quantify an individual's position along the Alzheimer's disease continuum together with its associated uncertainty. translated_title: 阿尔茨海默病连续谱中连续疾病位置的纵向贝叶斯学习
translated_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）作为一个连续的生物过程进展，而现有的大多数基于神经影像的人工智能方法仍局限于从横断面成像中进行离散诊断或临床评分预测。在本工作中，我们提出了疾病连续谱定位（DCP），一种纵向贝叶斯学习框架，能够从纵向扩散张量成像（DTI）中连续估计疾病严重程度。具体来说，DCP将疾病严重程度建模为低维概率潜在变量，通过联合整合纵向观察与弱临床监督，并由此推导出所提出的疾病连续谱评分（DCS），用于量化个体在阿尔茨海默病连续谱上的位置及其相关不确定性。在阿尔茨海默病神经影像倡议（ADNI）队列上的广泛实验表明，DCP持续优于代表性的离散诊断方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于纵向贝叶斯学习的DCP框架，通过连续概率建模和弱监督整合，实现了对阿尔茨海默病个体在连续谱上疾病位置的精确估计及其不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a longitudinal Bayesian learning framework DCP that continuously estimates disease severity and uncertainty along the Alzheimer's disease continuum via probabilistic latent modeling with weak supervision.
